title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add a unified rollout workflow that supports combined canary, A/B, and shadow traffic patterns with automated rollback based on multi-metric quorum and quarantine stages. Motivation: teams need a single declarative workflow that covers common release patterns (canary -> A/B -> shadow probing) and provides safer automatic rollback behavior when quality or latency regressions are detected. This PR introduces: 1) a new rollout controller workflow spec (unifiedRollout) that composes stages (canary, ab, shadow) and supports probe/quarantine sub-stages; 2) a multi-metric quorum policy for autorollback that evaluates latency, error-rate, and quality/regression metrics from eval hooks; 3) observability hooks to emit per-stage telemetry and a preflight probing run; 4) e2e and unit tests exercising rollback decision boundaries; 5) integration with existing release orchestration and routing layers. Checklist: - [x] rollout spec and controller implementation - [x] autorollback engine extension for multi-metric quorum - [x] telemetry events and dashboards updates - [x] unit tests for controller logic - [x] e2e tests against staging canary environment - [x] docs and examples updated. Backwards compatibility: the new unifiedRollout API is additive; legacy rollout configs are still supported. See linked Linear tasks for rollout design and SLO thresholds.
